summary: Wrote the refined executable contract to PLAN.md (workspace root, replacing the historical v4b PLAN.md) after verifying every interface claim of docs/SWARM_V9_PLAN.md against source at HEAD 05d7120. Verified by reading, not assuming: src/components/section/{SectionCanvas.tsx, contours.ts, contourWorker.ts, sectionAssets.ts, imageLayers.ts, planeGeometry.ts}, src/components/viewer3d/{SectionPiP.tsx, Viewer3D.tsx, SceneLayers.tsx, NucleusMesh.tsx, PlaneHelpers.tsx, clipPlanes.ts}, PlatesTab.tsx, src/state/store.ts, src/geometry/anatomyAssets.ts, src/assets/imaging/*-manifest.json + stain file inventory, src/data/{taxonomy.json, structures/*.json, sectionImages.ts, load.ts}, scripts/validate-data.mjs, and the gate scripts (section-pipeline.mjs, plane-transform.mjs, anatomy-qa.mjs, audit.mjs, audit-checks.test.mjs, a11y-contract.mjs, boundary-contract.mjs, budget-report.mjs). QUESTION (a): no reusable section-render entry point exists (SectionCanvas's frame/draw passes are module-private functions inside the component body, lines 1122-1390); the reachable path is a second SectionCanvas instance mounted in .pip-window, reusing contours.ts, contourWorker.ts, sectionAssets.ts and planeGeometry.ts verbatim - which also keeps the work inside task 4's write scope. QUESTION (b): the Atlas half exists (GLTFLoader + extractContours + planeTransform, exactly as scripts/verify/section-pipeline.mjs already does in Node), the image half must be built: CT/MRI from the committed .bin, 27 PNG plates with a built-in node:zlib decoder, and the 49 JPEG plates are unmeasurable without a new dependency and must be reported as such with their count. 17 numbered spec defects are recorded in PLAN.md section 7, the load-bearing ones being: (1) the pip-large/pip-small size toggle is NOT persisted (plain useState, line 1609), so a new key neuroaxis.sectionPipSize is required; (2) photo placement lives in src/data/sectionImages.ts, not in src/assets/imaging/**, so that file is added to task 3's scope; (3) re-baking the CT/MRI grids would fail verify:anatomy's legacy-level .bin invariant, so the correction must be display-time only; (4) the claim that somatotopy records appear in the live section 'for free' is false (the section paints anatomy-manifest parts only); (5) the lobe partition must be computed on the main thread, leaving contourWorker.ts untouched so verify:pipeline cannot regress; (14/15) verify:plane and audit-checks.test.mjs read SectionPiP.tsx as source text, so const SECTION_VIEWS (labels/flipX/up/cameraSide per axis) and a planeTransform( call must survive the rewrite. Frozen-gate status was measured here: validate, check, verify:pipeline (138/138 parts, 599204 tris) and verify:plane (10827 assertions) exit 0; verify:anatomy exits 1 in this sandbox only, because anatomy-qa.mjs:294 spawns powershell with piped stdio and the sandbox denies it (EPERM, errno -4048) before the verdict is printed - its three budget numbers were re-derived independently here (tris 599204 <= 800000, anatomy 13.89 <= 14 MB, imaging 8.71 <= 10 MB), and no browser gate was claimed. Evidence contract: PLAN.md exists and is non-empty (447 lines, 389 non-blank, 39317 bytes; the brief's 'under 400 lines' is exceeded by 47 lines - stated openly here rather than by dropping required content such as the per-task interfaces, the exact store keys and the numbered spec defects).
